findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

During this inspection the PIC was unable to show a verifiable manner in which the employees are notified of their responsibility to report potential foodborne illnesses and symptoms. A 10 day follow up lands on a Saturday. The scheduled follow up will be conducted on the following Monday. A blank copy of the Sangamon County Reporting Agreement will be given with the hand delivered report.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(3) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (3) Cleaning equipment and utensils as specified under 4-602.11(A) and sanitizing as specified under § 4-703.11.

The cooler in the back-stock area of the facility has mold growth observed on the cardboard at the bottom as well as on the edges of the door glass. The PIC was notified and instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward. Ensure that all food related equipment is maintained in a clean state at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

The mops in the back of the facility are observed stored with the heads in soiled water or pooled up in the bottom of mop buckets. Between uses these items should be stored so that the bristles are able to hang and drip dry effectively. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they’re instructed to handguns the bristles over the ringer so that the bristles could drip dry.
